title: Echelon Integration Execution Envelope v2
description: Execution envelope v2 (spec/echelon-integration-standard.md §5.1-§5.9). The actor IS the Praxis provenance actor and the optional provenance IS a praxis.provenance-record; both are referenced from the vendored Praxis schemas (schemas/vendor/praxis/SOURCE.json), never redefined. v1 (execution-envelope.schema.json) is frozen and remains valid.

actor.description: The actor performing THIS invocation (the current actor). Exactly the Praxis actor.

execution.description: The run performing this invocation: a propagated Praxis execution (ROS_EXECUTION_ID) or the caller's own namespaced run EXE-<system>.<run>. Absent means not known; never minted.

runIdentifiers.description: Session, conversation, and run identifiers of the current actor's runtime, when known. Literal "unknown" when applicable but not known; omitted when not applicable.

provenance.description: Provenance of the subject the invocation acts upon, carried verbatim. Its contributors (including the original actor) are distinct from the current `actor`.

carriedProvenance.description: A praxis.provenance-record of supported major 1 (validated against the contract), a record of any other major (carried verbatim, only the discriminator and version are checked), or a legacy unversioned {"contributions": ...} block read as version 1 (RQ-ROS-2026-A013).
